# 0001: Keep shared terminology at the root

Status: accepted

## Context

Humans and agents need one discoverable vocabulary.

## Decision

Maintain shared terms in the root GLOSSARY.md.

## Alternatives considered

A glossary under docs/reference/ would group reference material together, but readers would need to know that directory first. A root glossary gives new contributors a direct entry point.

## Consequences

Readers can locate vocabulary without knowing the documentation tree.
